implementation.training: Native posterior encoder, monotonic alignment search, stochastic or deterministic duration objective, flow, HiFi-GAN decoder, scale-plus-five-period discriminator, Slaney mel frontend, and separate discriminator/generator optimizer phases.
implementation.training_boundary: MMS-TTS config.json publishes the 513-bin posterior input and 256x decoder upsample factor, but not the FFT, window, mel, or segment settings used for training. VoiceHub therefore requires training_acoustic_config explicitly and never infers those values from the inference checkpoint.
